function gazyavaReveal(item,preview,cue=null,onDone=null){
 if(document.getElementById('gzReveal')){cue?.close();return;}
 const el=document.createElement('section');el.id='gzReveal';el.className='gz-reveal gz-v2';el.setAttribute('role','dialog');el.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');el.setAttribute('aria-label',item.name);
 el.innerHTML=`<div class="gz-nebula"></div><div class="gz-halo"></div><div class="gz-floor"></div><canvas></canvas><div class="gz-result"><small>${preview?'ПРЕДПРОСМОТР':'МИФИЧЕСКИЙ ОБЛИК'}</small><h2>${item.name}</h2><div class="gz-hero"><img src="${item.image}" alt="${item.name}"></div><button>Продолжить</button></div><button class="gz-skip">Пропустить анимацию</button>`;document.body.append(el);document.body.classList.add('gz-fx-active');
 const canvas=el.querySelector('canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const fromSpin=!!cue;cue=cue||createGazyavaCue();
 let raf=0,closed=false,start=performance.now(),W=0,H=0,revealed=false;const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 const resize=()=>{const d=Math.min(1,devicePixelRatio||1,720/Math.max(1,el.clientWidth),1100/Math.max(1,el.clientHeight));W=el.clientWidth;H=el.clientHeight;canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(W*d));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(H*d));if(ctx)ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);};resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
 const motes=Array.from({length:36},(_,i)=>({x:((i*73)%101)/101,y:((i*37)%103)/103,s:1+(i%5)*.6,v:.06+(i%9)*.009}));
 function done(){if(closed)return;closed=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);cue.close();window.removeEventListener('resize',resize);document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);el.remove();document.body.classList.remove('gz-fx-active');render();onDone?.();}
 function visibility(){if(document.hidden){cue.pause();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);}else if(!closed){cue.play();if(!reduced&&ctx)raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);}}
 function reveal(){if(revealed)return;revealed=true;cue.seekReveal();el.classList.add('revealed');}
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);el.querySelector('.gz-result button').onclick=done;el.querySelector('.gz-skip').onclick=()=>{start=performance.now()-2700;reveal();};
 const flameSprite=document.createElement('canvas');flameSprite.width=192;flameSprite.height=192;const fc=flameSprite.getContext('2d');
 if(fc){const g=fc.createRadialGradient(96,96,0,96,96,86);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(185,248,255,.82)');g.addColorStop(.18,'rgba(36,187,255,.83)');g.addColorStop(.46,'rgba(0,82,255,.6)');g.addColorStop(.76,'rgba(19,33,190,.23)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,22,155,0)');fc.fillStyle=g;fc.fillRect(0,0,192,192);fc.translate(96,96);fc.rotate(-.63);fc.fillStyle='rgba(58,181,255,.28)';fc.beginPath();fc.moveTo(-31,38);fc.bezierCurveTo(-74,-11,15,-32,-15,-93);fc.bezierCurveTo(53,-46,47,14,22,42);fc.closePath();fc.fill();}
 function flame(x,y,r,alpha,t,seed){if(!fc||alpha<=0||x+r*1.2<0||x-r*1.2>W||y+r*1.2<0||y-r*1.2>H)return;ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,alpha));const size=r*2.23;ctx.drawImage(flameSprite,x-size/2,y-size/2,size,size);ctx.globalAlpha=1;}
 let lastFrame=-Infinity;
 function frame(now){if(closed||!ctx)return;if(now-lastFrame<30){raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);return;}lastFrame=now;const t=(now-start)/1000;ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const unit=Math.min(W,H);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
 // Wide diagonal wave moves from lower right toward upper left, with overlapping tongues and a luminous core.
 if(t<2.65){const u=Math.min(1,t/2.05),lead=1.55-2.15*u,fade=t>2.05?Math.max(0,1-(t-2.05)/.60):1;for(let layer=0;layer<3;layer++){for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const f=i/17,delta=layer*.13,xx=W*(lead+f*.72+delta)+Math.sin(f*17+t*9+layer)*unit*.055,yy=H*(lead+(1-f)*.56+delta)+Math.cos(f*19+t*7+layer)*unit*.08;const rad=unit*(.11+.055*Math.sin(i*2.4+t*8+layer)+layer*.018);flame(xx,yy,rad,fade*(.68-layer*.12),t,i+layer*4);}}}
 if(!revealed){const q=Math.min(1,t/2.5);cue.setProgress(fromSpin ? .82+.18*q : q);}if(t>=2.5)reveal();
 // Ambient flames stay near the edges after the character is revealed.
 if(revealed){for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const side=i%2,phase=(t*.43+i*.179)%1,y=H*(1.06-phase*.89),x=W*(side?.92:.08)+Math.sin(t*3+i*1.9)*unit*.075;flame(x,y,unit*(.05+.045*(1-phase)),(1-phase)*.42,t,i);}}
 for(const p of motes){const q=(p.y+t*p.v)%1.15,x=W*(p.x+.045*Math.sin(t*1.7+p.y*17)),y=H*(1.08-q);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(101,217,255,${.15+.5*Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.min(1,q))})`;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,p.s,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
 ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
 // Small stylized blue collection emblems drifting around the result, not physical equipment.
 if(revealed){for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const q=(t*.12+i/8)%1,x=W*(i%2?.85:.15)+Math.sin(t*1.4+i)*unit*.075,y=H*(1.02-q*.94);ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(Math.sin(t+i)*.65);ctx.globalAlpha=Math.sin(q*Math.PI)*.48;const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(-10,0,10,0);g.addColorStop(0,'#052360');g.addColorStop(.5,'#1d95fa');g.addColorStop(1,'#052360');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.strokeStyle='#74dfff';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(-9,-15,18,30,5);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#dbf5ff';ctx.font='bold 11px Arial';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('♛',0,4);ctx.restore();}}
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);}
 if(reduced||!ctx)reveal();else raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

function vorsinReveal(item,message,music,onClose){
 const old=document.querySelector('.vorsin-reveal');if(old){if(typeof old._stopVorsin==='function')old._stopVorsin();else old.remove();}const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='vorsin-reveal vr-'+(item.cue?item.id:'epic');el.setAttribute('role','dialog');el.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');el.setAttribute('aria-label','Награда: '+item.name);
 el.innerHTML=`<div class="vr-rays"></div><div class="vr-halo"></div>${item.id==='hero'?'<div class="vr-city">'+Array.from({length:18},(_,i)=>'<i style="height:'+(30+(i*41)%70)+'%"></i>').join('')+'</div>':''}<div class="vr-title"><small>КЕЙС ВОРСИНА</small>Получение награды</div><img class="vr-character" src="${item.image}" alt="${item.name}"><canvas class="vr-canvas"></canvas><div class="vr-caption"></div><button class="vr-close">Пропустить</button>`;
 document.body.append(el);const title=el.querySelector('.vr-title'),caption=el.querySelector('.vr-caption'),btn=el.querySelector('.vr-close'),canvas=el.querySelector('canvas'),g=canvas.getContext('2d');let raf=0,closed=false,shown=false,source=null,start=performance.now(),audioStart=null,particles=[],lastBurst=-1,lastFall=-1;
 const dpr=Math.min(1.5,devicePixelRatio||1),w=el.clientWidth,h=el.clientHeight;canvas.width=w*dpr;canvas.height=h*dpr;g.scale(dpr,dpr);const colors=['#ffdc70','#b87bff','#ffefba','#fe7bc7','#7fe8ff','#ffa94d'];
 function burst(x,y,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=45+Math.random()*170;particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,life:1.2+Math.random(),size:2+Math.random()*3,color:colors[i%colors.length],kind:'spark'});}}
 function fall(kind,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++)particles.push({x:Math.random()*w,y:-25-Math.random()*80,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*65,vy:80+Math.random()*140,life:7,size:kind==='confetti'?4+Math.random()*7:20+Math.random()*13,color:colors[i%colors.length],kind,rot:Math.random()*6.28});}
 function reveal(){if(shown)return;shown=true;el.classList.add('vr-ready');title.innerHTML='<small>'+item.rarity.toUpperCase()+'</small>'+(item.id==='vorsin'?'ПОЗДРАВЛЯЕМ!<br>ВОРСИН':item.name);caption.textContent=message;btn.textContent='Забрать';if(!reduced){burst(w*.5,h*.42,item.id==='vorsin'?85:36);if(item.id==='vorsin'){fall('confetti',45);fall('burger',14);}if(item.id==='bull')fall('gold',24);}}
 function stop(){if(closed)return;closed=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);clearTimeout(fallback);try{source?.stop();}catch{}music.close();el.remove();onClose();}el._stopVorsin=stop;
 btn.onclick=()=>{if(!shown){reveal();return;}stop();};
 let previous=performance.now();const cue=item.cue||.45;let armed=!item.cue||!music.ctx;let fallback=setTimeout(()=>{if(!armed){armed=true;start=performance.now();}},1200);
 if(music.ctx){music.buffer.then(b=>{if(closed||armed)return;clearTimeout(fallback);const ctx=music.ctx;if(b&&ctx.state==='running'){try{source=ctx.createBufferSource();source.buffer=b;const gain=ctx.createGain();gain.gain.value=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,state.volume/100));source.connect(gain);gain.connect(ctx.destination);audioStart=ctx.currentTime+.025;source.start(audioStart);}catch{audioStart=null;}}start=performance.now();armed=true;}).catch(()=>{armed=true;start=performance.now();});}
 function frame(now){if(closed)return;const t=Math.max((now-start)/1000,audioStart!==null&&music.ctx?.state==='running'?Math.max(0,music.ctx.currentTime-audioStart):0);const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-previous)/1000);previous=now;if((armed||t>=1.2)&&t>=cue)reveal();if(shown&&!reduced){const after=Math.max(0,t-cue);const b=Math.floor(after/.68);if(item.id==='vorsin'&&b!==lastBurst&&after<7){lastBurst=b;burst((.15+Math.random()*.7)*w,(.13+Math.random()*.44)*h,44);}const f=Math.floor(after/.38);if(f!==lastFall&&after<6){lastFall=f;if(item.id==='vorsin'){fall('confetti',13);fall('burger',3);}else if(item.id==='bull')fall('gold',6);else if(item.id==='hero')burst(w*.5,h*.44,12);}
 g.clearRect(0,0,w,h);for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=dt*(p.kind==='spark'?92:36);p.life-=dt;g.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p.life));if(p.kind==='burger'||p.kind==='gold'){g.save();g.translate(p.x,p.y);g.rotate(p.rot+=dt*1.7);if(p.kind==='burger'){g.font=p.size+'px sans-serif';g.textAlign='center';g.fillText('🍔',0,0);}else{g.fillStyle='#ffcb53';g.strokeStyle='#fff2ac';g.lineWidth=2;g.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size*.28,p.size,p.size*.56);g.strokeRect(-p.size/2,-p.size*.28,p.size,p.size*.56);g.fillStyle='#bb7d1d';g.fillRect(-p.size/2,p.size*.15,p.size,p.size*.12);}g.restore();}else{g.fillStyle=p.color;g.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.size,p.kind==='confetti'?p.size*.45:p.size);}}g.globalAlpha=1;particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0&&p.y<h+80).slice(-260);}
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);}raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

const forestKingCueBase64="";
function syavaAudio(withKingCue=false){let ctx;const silent={play(){},close(){},kingCue(){},royal(){return false;}};try{const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!C||state.muted||!state.volume)return silent;ctx=new C();ctx.resume().catch(()=>{});}catch{return silent;}const gain=ctx.createGain();gain.gain.value=.09*state.volume/100;gain.connect(ctx.destination);let closed=false,closeTimer=0;const kingCueBuffer=withKingCue?ctx.decodeAudioData(Uint8Array.from(atob(forestKingCueBase64),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer).catch(()=>null):Promise.resolve(null);return {kingCue(delay=1.5){const false;try{const t=ctx.currentTime+.035;const level=state.volume/100;const chord=(f,at,d,amp,type='triangle')=>{const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,at);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,at);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(amp*level,at+.025);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,at+d);o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);o.start(at);o.stop(at+d+.02);};[65.41,98,130.81].forEach(f=>chord(f,t,4.4,.075,'sine'));for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const f=[130.81,196,261.63,293.66,392,523.25][i%6];chord(f,t+i*.34,.65,.11,'triangle');chord(65.41,t+i*.34,.15,.09,'sine');}const hit=t+4.2;[49,98,196,261.63,392,523.25,783.99].forEach((f,i)=>chord(f,hit+i*.018,i<2?1.5:2.1,.1,i<2?'sine':'triangle'));return true;}catch{return false;}},play(kind){if(ctx.state==='closed')return;try{const t=ctx.currentTime,o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),d=kind==='tick'?.035:.16;o.type=kind==='tick'?'triangle':'sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(kind==='tick'?1250:kind==='open'?210:640,t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(kind==='tick'?370:kind==='open'?100:420,t+d);g.gain.setValueAtTime(kind==='tick'?.28:.6,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+d);o.connect(g);g.connect(gain);o.start(t);o.stop(t+d+.01);}catch{}},close(delay=220){if(closed)return;closed=true;clearTimeout(closeTimer);closeTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(ctx.state!=='closed')ctx.close().catch(()=>{});},delay);}};}
